items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Charlie Harris was on bass... after I joined him... we went abroad

ctx.x: Yeah, I started conducting for him, because after I rehearsed at that time, you know, he saw that we got through in a hurry, and then I started conducting for him. I would conduct from the drums -- the drums always sat right down in front of the band, and I conducted all over the country for him. We -- in '53, also, after I joined him, we went to - and in March of '54 -- we went abroad, you know, and we got to London, we were gonna play the Palladium and they didn't want John Collins and Charlie Harris and myself…
the reciprocal thing came about. They argued it out and argued it out, and so if they would allow us to play, then the States was supposed to take Ted Heath, the next year, right?
